entities.title: Market and hold
entities.summary: The 17 goods, their prices and availability, the per-visit market byte and hold space.
entities.purpose: Owns RULES A.9 and A.11: the goods table, price and availability formulas from a system's economy and the market byte, drawing the byte on arrival, and what fits in the hold.
boundaries: A capability: it uses no feature or use case (tests/layers.rs).
Callers pass the current system's economy; the market never looks a system up.
The goods data are the GDD's (§ 4.7, § 5.1, § 5.2).
